subject: Animation
title: Ralph Bakshi: Animation for Adults
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ralph Bakshi: Animation for Adults.

hook.text: Ralph Bakshi directed Fritz the Cat in 1972 — the first X-rated animated feature film in American history.

buildup.text: Bakshi used animation to tackle racism, urban poverty, and political corruption during the counterculture era.

discovery.text: Fritz the Cat became a massive underground hit, proving that adults would pay to watch animated films.

twist.text: Disney and mainstream studios shunned Bakshi. His films were seen as threatening the family-friendly brand.

climax.text: Bakshi opened the door for every adult animated film and show that followed, from Akira to BoJack Horseman.

punchline.text: An X-rated cartoon proved animation could speak to adults.

quiz.question: Why was Ralph Bakshi significant in animation history?
options: He directed the first Disney sequel
He directed Fritz the Cat, the first X-rated animated feature, proving adults would watch animated films
